networkPolicy.desc: Braze marketing messages are blocked; rides and payment stay open

notes: Written from the binary and from the tunnel. On launch it reached api-*.prod.birdapp.com and Braze. Blocked: Braze, which delivers in-app marketing messages and content cards. The sign in screen's background video is res/raw/intro_video.mp4 inside the APK, so no host carries it and no policy can block it; that is what the entry's flag is for.
